summary: The form labels and submit button inside the Sign Up card shifted from left-aligned to centered, creating a layout misalignment with the left-aligned section heading and left-aligned input fields.

regressions.explanation: The Username label moved from its left-aligned position (box 1) to the horizontal center of the card, leaving it misaligned with the left-aligned input placeholder and section heading.
The Password label moved from its left-aligned position (box 3) to the horizontal center of the card, breaking alignment with the left-aligned password input field.

The Sign Up button shifted from its left-aligned position (box 5) to the center along with the form labels, which appears to be an unintended side effect of centering text alignment on the form container.
